lhs: Generate on a rectangular source frame, then reshape by row-major flat position.
rhs: Generate directly on the same-volume destination frame.
types: Arbitrary draw payload; common shape-independent linear stream.

overlap: This is a common-stream calculation. It assumes a shape-insensitive generator; shape-dependent algorithms are outside the model.

lhs: Observe the probability of each complete transposed rectangular Boolean array drawn from an iid source.
rhs: Generate that matrix directly in the transposed shape with the same finite iid weights.
types: Integer-weighted binary draws, strictly positive total weight, including point support and fair Boolean uniforms.
conditions: Inverse transpose selects the old matrix. Row-major products of all cell weights and both normalizers agree. Shared-seed pointwise observations and purely marginal constraints do not imply this law.
overlap: One joint-law result, not a second refutation for a stronger same-seed property; correlated balanced-marginal controls distinguish the assumptions.
